'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**The casualty toll from [[Hurricane Melissa]] in [[Haiti]] increases to 43 deaths, with 13 others still missing. Nearly 12,000 homes are flooded and at least 200 have been destroyed. [https://apnews.com/article/melissa-haiti-jamaica-hurricane-storm-caribbean-bbc009020e6a2a8150ccecc5b6370833 (AP)]
*[[2025 Chhattisgarh train collision]]
**At least eight people are killed and about a dozen others are injured when a [[passenger train]] [[Railway accident|crashes into]] a [[cargo train]] near [[Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh|Bilaspur]], [[Chhattisgarh]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-train-crash-bilaspur-fatalities-14dea2aaf55b2fee62d9839569a6ec84 (AP)]
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll from [[Typhoon Kalmaegi]]'s impact on [[Visayas]] and [[Mindanao]], [[Philippines]], rises to 66, with [[search and rescue]] operations ongoing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgmx4yjkzj4o (BBC News)]
**Six people are killed when a [[Philippine Air Force]] [[Bell Huey family|Bell Huey]] helicopter crashes while conducting damage assessment for Typhoon Kalmaegi in [[Loreto, Agusan del Sur]], Philippines. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2134041/paf-chopper-with-6-on-board-crashes-in-agusan-del-sur-source (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/typhoon-kalmaegi-brings-life-threatening-conditions-central-philippines-2025-11-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[UPS Airlines Flight 2976]]
**14 people are killed, including the three crew members and 11 on the ground, and fifteen others are injured when [[UPS Airlines]] [[McDonnell Douglas MD-11]] aircraft crashes near [[Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport]] in [[Kentucky]], [[United States]] shortly after takeoff. [https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/ups-plane-crash-louisville-airport?t=1762304462767 (CNN)]
*[[Tuzla retirement home fire]]
**Eleven people are killed and about 30 others are injured in a fire at a [[retirement home]] in [[Tuzla]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/death-toll-rises-11-fire-bosnian-retirement-home-2025-11-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Sexual and gender-based violence against Palestinians during the Gaza war]]
***[[Israel]]i [[major general]] [[Yifat Tomer-Yerushalmi]] is arrested and imprisoned a day after resigning, after leaking a [[surveillance video]] in August 2024 showing the [[gang rape]] of a [[Palestinian prisoners in Israeli custody|Palestinian prisoner]] in the [[Sde Teiman detention camp]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/5/israels-focus-on-political-drama-rather-than-palestinian-rape-victim (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.npr.org/2025/11/04/g-s1-96413/israel-scandal-top-military-lawyer-thrown-into-jail (NPR)]
*[[Violence against women in Mexico]]
**[[President of Mexico]] [[Claudia Sheinbaum]] is [[Groping|groped]] in front of the [[National Palace (Mexico)|National Palace]], Mexico City. The man is arrested on the spot. [https://www.informador.mx/mexico/claudia-sheinbaum-detienen-a-hombre-que-acoso-sexualmente-a-la-presidenta-20251104-0194.html (''Informador'' <small>in Spanish</small>)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/groping-mexicos-president-highlights-violence-against-women-2025-11-05/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Constitutional Court]] of [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] confirms former [[Republika Srpska]] [[President of Republika Srpska|president]] [[Milorad Dodik]]'s six-year ban from [[Politics of Bosnia and Herzegovina|political office]], rejecting Dodik's appeals and ruling that the ban did not violate the [[Constitution of Bosnia and Herzegovina|constitution]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/bosnias-top-court-confirms-political-ban-former-bosnian-serb-leader-2025-11-04/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Morocco|Moroccan]] [[Judiciary of Morocco|court]] sentences a man to five years in prison and fines him [[United States dollar|US$]]107,300 for [[Human trafficking in Morocco|human trafficking]] after he recruited jobseekers online who were later [[Human trafficking in Myanmar|transported]] to [[Myanmar]] and [[Forced labour|forced to work]] in [[scam center]]s, marking the country's first conviction involving the recruitment of victims for foreign scam compounds. [https://apnews.com/article/morocco-scam-centers-prison-trafficking-dbcd643dd39d013409796257c421b9d5 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 United States elections]]
**[[Off-year election]]s are held in the [[United States]], including one [[2025 Texas's 18th congressional district special election|special election]] to a vacancy in the [[United States House of Representatives|federal House of Representatives]], two [[2025 United States gubernatorial elections|elections for the governors]] of [[2025 Virginia gubernatorial election|Virginia]] and [[2025 New Jersey gubernatorial election|New Jersey]], the next [[2025 New York City mayoral election|mayor of New York City]], and various local elections. [https://www.npr.org/2025/11/01/nx-s1-5593453/election-day-results-questions (NPR)]
**[[Abigail Spanberger]] is elected as the [[Governor of Virginia|governor]] of [[Virginia]] to become the [[U.S. state|state]]'s first female governor. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/nov/04/virginia-governor-abigail-spanberger (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Zohran Mamdani]] is elected as the 111th [[Mayor of New York City|mayor]] of [[New York City]] to become the city's first [[Islam in New York City|Muslim]] and [[South Asian American]] mayor. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/11/5/nyc-mayoral-election-results-live-polls-closing-soon-in-mamdani-cuomo-race (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251105-progressive-democrat-zohran-mamdani-wins-new-york-city-mayoral-race (France 24)]
*[[2025 United States federal government shutdown]]
**The [[Federal government of the United States|U.S. federal government]] [[Government shutdowns in the United States|shutdown]] becomes the longest shutdown in American history following a failed 14th vote by the [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]], surpassing the [[2018–2019 United States federal government shutdown|2018–2019 shutdown]] that occurred during [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[First presidency of Donald Trump|first term]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/government-shutdown-latest-record-history-trump-senate-votes/ (CBS News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Mexico|Mexican]] [[President of Mexico|president]] [[Claudia Sheinbaum]] announces a security plan for the [[List of states of Mexico|state]] of [[Michoacán]] following the [[assassination]] of the [[mayor]] of [[Uruapan]], [[Carlos Manzo]], who was shot and killed on Saturday. The plan includes the dispatch of the [[National Guard (Mexico)|National Guard]], more [[Federal Police (Mexico)|federal personnel]], and the creation of a special unit at the state's prosecution office. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-security-sheinbaum-michoacan-mayor-3ef190f8d11c05d4b44c5765b6bcfc07 (AP)]
*[[Western Sahara conflict]]
**[[Morocco]] declares October 31, starting next year, to be a [[Public holidays in Morocco|national holiday]] in celebration of Friday's [[United Nations resolution|UN resolution]] backing [[Western Sahara Autonomy Proposal|Morocco's plan]] of autonomy for [[Western Sahara]] in a 50-year dispute between the country and the [[Algeria]]-backed [[Polisario Front]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/morocco-declares-national-holiday-mark-un-resolution-western-sahara-2025-11-04/ (Reuters)]
